incident_description: The nightly_inventory_reconciliation pipeline failed during the gold-layer reconciliation join. An executor ran out of memory mid-join, and the job aborted after only partially writing its output.
execution_logs: 2026-08-21 03:00:10 INFO Extracting warehouse snapshots from warehouse_management_system
2026-08-21 03:07:15 INFO Silver transformation completed successfully, 892340 rows
2026-08-21 03:08:02 INFO Starting gold_inventory_reconciliation join across 6 warehouse regions
2026-08-21 03:31:47 WARN Executor 14 memory usage at 94% of container limit
2026-08-21 03:33:12 ERROR ExecutorLostFailure: Executor 17 exited caused by out of memory (OOM). Container killed by YARN for exceeding memory limits. 18.2 GB of 18 GB physical memory used
2026-08-21 03:33:15 ERROR Job aborted due to stage failure: task 442 in stage 9.0 failed 4 times, most recent failure: ExecutorLostFailure
2026-08-21 03:33:16 WARN Partial write detected: 3 of 8 output partitions committed before failure
2026-08-21 03:33:19 INFO Downstream jobs were not started

sql_info.query: SELECT w.region, w.sku, w.on_hand_qty, s.in_transit_qty, s.supplier_id FROM silver_inventory_events w JOIN supplier_intransit_events s ON w.sku = s.sku AND w.region = s.region

recent_changes.change: EMEA region (3 new warehouses) onboarded; daily inventory event volume increased approximately 40%.
No-code pipeline configuration update: join strategy for supplier_intransit_events changed from broadcast to standard shuffle join.

business_context.sla: inventory_position_report must refresh by 05:00 to support the 06:00 regional replenishment planning run
business_context.business_impact: Replenishment planning across all 6 regions will run on stale or incomplete inventory data, risking incorrect reorder quantities, especially in the newly onboarded EMEA region.

expected_root_cause_for_testing.root_cause: The gold_inventory_reconciliation join ran out of executor memory: a recent config change disabled the broadcast join for supplier_intransit_events, forcing a full shuffle join right as EMEA onboarding increased data volume by roughly 40%. The job aborted mid-write with only 3 of 8 output partitions committed.
expected_root_cause_for_testing.recommended_fix: Re-enable (or explicitly configure) the broadcast join for supplier_intransit_events, or increase executor memory to match the post-EMEA data volume. Clear the partially-committed gold partitions and rerun gold_inventory_reconciliation from a clean state, then re-baseline resource sizing now that EMEA volume is part of steady-state load.
expected_root_cause_for_testing.note: This section is included only so you can verify agent accuracy during development. Remove it later when testing the agents without revealing the answer.

test_design_notes: This fixture intentionally differs from data_engineering_incident_test.json to exercise different branches of the 5-prompt chain: error_category resource_limit_exceeded instead of schema_mismatch; data-quality failures on row_count, null_rate, AND freshness while schema_check PASSes (the first file only failed row_count + schema); a 3-hop dependency graph with explicit criticality_tags including 'critical' nodes (the first file never reached criticality above 'high' and had no explicit tags, only inferred ones); and two competing contributing factors (a config change plus a volume increase) instead of one single clear cause, so rank-root-causes has something real to weigh rather than an obvious single answer.
